text: Mongolia has committed to set a national voluntary LDN target, establish an LDN baseline, and formulate associated measures to achieve LDN.
label: LDN commitment

sources.sourceText:
Mongolia has committed to set a national voluntary LDN target, establish an LDN
baseline, and formulate associated measures to achieve LDN.

Mongolia is among the countries that have committed to set a
national voluntary LDN target, establish an LDN baseline, and formulate associated measures.

text: Restore 0.6 million hectares of degraded land under the Bonn Challenge.
label: Bonn Challenge restoration

sources.sourceText:
The LDN targets provide Mongolia with a strong vehicle for fostering coherence of policies and actions by aligning
the national LDN targets with measures from the Nationally Determined Contributions and other national
commitments, such as the restoration of 0.6 million hectares of degraded land under the Bonn Challenge.
